description1.1a: These numbers determine how long (in ticks) an egg will take to hatch.
description1.1b: The default values are 700 minimum (35 seconds) and 6000 max (5 minutes).

description2.2a: This number determines how often a mob will drop their spawn egg.
description2.2b: The default number is 0.005, which is 0.5% chance to drop. Higher values means higher chances to drop.

description3.3a: This configration determines if the mobspawner should be dropped when mined.
description3.3b: Set it to true or false.

description4.4a: This configration determines if Spawn Eggs should be dropped when you kill an entity.
description4.4b: Set it to true or false.
